Amharic: ከተለያዩ ጥናቶች ስለ አንድ ርዕሰ ጉዳይ መረጃ መሰብሰብን የሚያካትት ዲበ-ትንታኔን አካሂደዋል።

Source: They looked at scientific papers published between 1999 and 2018 focussing on Bilharzia in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Baatunuulira empapula z’okunoonyereza kw’ekinnassaayansi ezaafulumizibwa mu 1999 ne 2018 nga beemalidde ku Bilharzia mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo àwọn bébà tí ó jẹ mọ́ ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì tí wọ́n tẹ̀ jáde láàárín ọdún 1999 àti 2018, èyí tí ó gbájúmọ́ Bilharzia ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqe ulwazi emaphepheni esayensi ashicilelwe phakathi konyaka wezi-1999 kuya kowezi- 2018, ucwaningo beligxile ekudlangeni kwe-Bilharzia ezweni lase-Ethopia.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba takardun kimiyya da aka buga a tsakanin shekarar 1999 da kuma 2018 suna masu mayar da hankali a kan Bilharziya a ƙasar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela dimpampiri tša mahlale tšeo di gatišitšwego magareng ga 1999 le 2018 gomme tšona di lebeletše Bilharzia ka Ethiopia.
Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ በ1999 እና 2018 መካከል ቢልሃርዚያ ላይ በማተኮር የታተሙ ሳይንሳዊ ጽሑፎችን ተመልክተዋል።

Source: They found 140 articles, but only included 84 in this study.
Luganda: Baazuula empapula 140 naye nga mu kunoonyereza kuno, beekaliriza 84 zokka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àwárí atíkù 140, ṣùgbọ́n 84 nìkan ni wọ́n ṣe àmúlò nínú iṣẹ́ ìwaìí yìí.
Zulu: Bathola amaphepha angama-140 kodwa angama-84 abawasebenzisile kulolu cwaningo.
Hausa: Sun sami maƙalu guda 140, amma sun haɗa da 84 kawai ne a cikin wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše diathekele tše 140, eupša ba akaretša fela tše 84 ka mo dinyakišišong tše.
Amharic: 140 ጽሑፎችን አግኝተዋል፣ ነገር ግን በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ 84 ብቻ አካተዋል።

Source: They found that since 2014, many had the infection - nearly 20% of the Ethiopian population.
Luganda: Baazuula nti okuva mu 2014, bangi abaalina obulwadde obwo – kumpi ebitundu 20% eby’abantu mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àwárí pé láti 2014, ọ̀pọ̀ ní àrùn ìrànmọ́ni – ó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó ìdá 20% àwọn olùgbé Ethiopia.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi babalelwa kuma-20% abantu ababe chaphazeleke ngalesi sifo kubantu bonke base-Ethopia ngo-2014.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa tun daga shekarar 2014, da yawa sun kamu da cutar - kusan kashi 20% na al'ummar ƙasar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore go tloga ka 2014, ba bantši ba bile le phetetšo – e lego palo ya kgauswi le 20% ya setšhaba sa ka Ethiopia.
Amharic: ከ 2014 ጀምሮ፣ 20% የሚሆነው የኢትዮጵያ ህዝብ ብዙዎች በቫይረሱ ​​​​የተያዙ ናቸው።

Source: They noticed that most cases were found in the southern part of Ethiopia, in the rural areas, and in males.
Luganda: Baakiraba nti obulwadde obusinga bwali mu kitundu kya bukiikaddyo bwa ethiopia, mu bitundu by’ekyalo ate ne mu basajja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àkíyèsí pé ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn tí wọ́n ní àrun yìí jẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n wà ní Gúúsù Ethiopia, ní àwọn ìgbèríkò, àti àwọn ọkùnrin.
Zulu: Abakunaka kakhulu abacwaning ukuthi izigameko eziningi zokosabalala kwalesi sifo zazenzenka ezindaweni zasemaphandleni eziseNingizimi yase-Ethopia, futhi sasitholakala kakhulu kubantu besilisa isifo.
Hausa: Sun lura cewa an samu yawancin kamuwa da cutar a kudancin ƙasar Habasha, a yankunan karkara, kuma a cikin maza.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gore diphetetšo tše ntši di hweditšwe ka karolong ya borwa bja Ethiopia, ka mafelong a dinagamagaeng, le go banna.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ጉዳዮች በደቡብ የኢትዮጵያ ክፍል፣ በገጠር እና በወንዶች እንደሚገኙ አስተውለዋል።

Source: The researchers said however that most of their data came from people in cities or towns, and so some of the cases in rural areas may have not been recorded.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti wadde nga kyali kityo, obubaka obusinga bwava mu bantu abali mu bibuba oba mu bubuga, kitegeeza nti obulwadde obumu mu bitundu by’ekyalo buyinza okuba nga tebwamanyibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀ nínú àwọn dátà wọn ní ó wá láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n wà ní àwọn ìlú ńlá tàbí àwọn ìlú kékèké, fún ìdí èyí díẹ̀ nínú àwọn kéèì tí ó wà ní ìgbèríko lè má wwà ní àkọsílẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakubalula ukuthi ulwazi oluningi babeluqoqa ezindaweni zasemadolobheni, okwenza ukuthi bagcine bengakwazanga okuqoqa ulwazi olwanele ezindaweni ezisemaphandlleni.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce duk da haka yawancin bayanan nasu sun fito ne daga mutane a birane ko garuruwa, don haka, wataƙila ba a rubuta kamuwa da cutar a yankunan karkara ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore le ge go le bjale gore bontši bja tshedimošo ya bona e be e etšwa go batho ba ka ditoropokgolong gob aba ka ditoropong, gomme tše dingwe tša diphetetšo tša ka dinagamagaeng di ka be di se tša begwa.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግን አብዛኛው ውሂባቸው በከተሞች ወይም በከተሞች ውስጥ ካሉ ሰዎች የመጣ ነው፣ እና ስለዚህ በገጠር አካባቢዎች አንዳንድ ጉዳዮች ያልተመዘገቡ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ተናግረዋል።

Source: They also cautioned that the individual studies they looked at each had their own limitations, which may skew the results of this meta-analysis.
Luganda: Era baalabula nti okunoonyereza kinnakumu kwe baatunuulira, buli kumu kwalina ebikukugira eby’enjawulo, era kino kino okukosa ebyava mu kwekaliriza kw’okunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún kìlọ̀ pé àwọn ìwádìí ọlọ́dani tí wọ́n ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò ni wọ́n ní ìdíwọ́ wọn, èyí tí ó lè fa ìdíwọ́ fún àwọn èsì àtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́ ìṣirò onírúurú ìwádìí sáyẹ́ńsì.
Zulu: Baphinde basiqwashisa ngokuthi amaphepha ahlukahlukene abawahlaziya eyonolwazi olungaphelela, okungaba nomthelela omgemuhle uma sekuhlaziyiwa ulwazi abaliqoqile ngokuhlukahlukana kwalo.
Hausa: Har ila yau, masu binciken sun yi gargaɗin cewa ɗaiɗaikun binciken da suka duba kowanne suna da tasa gazawar, wanda zai iya karkatar da sakamakon wannan nazarin binciken da suka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba lemoša gore dinyakišišo tšeo ba ilego ba di lekola ka e tee ka e tee di bile le mellwane ya tšona, gomme se se ka phamoša dipoelo tša tshekatshekokgolo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም እያንዳንዳቸው የተመለከቱዋቸው ግለሰባዊ ጥናቶች የራሳቸው ውስንነት እንዳላቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል፣ ይህም የዚህን ዲበ-ትንተና ውጤቶችን ሊያዛባ ይችላል።

Source: Based on the high number of people that have Bilharzia in Ethiopia, the authors suggested that the government should try to stop access to open water sources, and they should educate the communities about the dangers of dirty water.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku muwendo gw’abantu abalina Bilharzia mu Ethiopia, abanoonyereza bateesa nti gavumenti zirina okugezaako okuyimiriza enkozesa y’amazzi agali mu kyangaala era balina okusomesa abantu ku bulabe obuli mu mazzi amakyafu.
Yoruba: Látàrí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn tí ó ní Bilharzia ní Ethiopia, oǹkọ̀wé gbàá ní ìmọ̀ràn pé kí àwọn ìjọba gbìyànjú láti mú ìdádúró bá bi àwọn ènìyàn ṣe ṣàmúlò omi tí ó dọ̀tí, kí wọ́n kọ́ àwọn ará ìlú nípa ewu tí ó wà nínú ìlò oi tí ó dọ̀tí.
Zulu: Ngenxa yenani labantu abaningi abatholakala bephethwe i-Bilharzia, ababhali babeka ombono wokuthi, uhulumeni kumele aqhamuke nezindlela zongwema ukuthi abantu basebenzise amanzi atholakala noma ikephi, aphinde afundise umphakathi ngobungozi obulethwa ukusebenzisa amanzi agcolile.
Hausa: Dangane da yawan mutanen da suke da cutar Bilharzia a ƙasar Habasha, marubutan sun bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata gwamnati ta yi ƙoƙarin hana hanyoyin samun dama da tushen buɗaɗɗen ruwa, kuma su wayar da kan al'umma game da illolin da suke tattare da ƙazantaccen ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Go ya ka palo ya godimo ya batho bao ba nago le Bilharzia ka Ethiopia, bangwadi ba ile ba šišinya gore mmušo o swanetše go leka go thibela phihlelelo go meetse a ka godimo ga mobu, gomme ba swanetše go ruta ditšhaba ka ga dikotsi tša meetse a ditšhila.
Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ የቢልሃርዚያ በሽታ ያለባቸውን ሰዎች ቁጥር በመመልከት፣ መንግስት ክፍት የውሃ ምንጮችን ተደራሽነት ለማቆም ጥረት ማድረግ እንዳለበት እና ህብረተሰቡ ስለ ቆሻሻ ውሃ አደገኛነት ማስተማር እንዳለበት ጠቁመዋል።

Source: They also recommended boosting water treatment programs in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Era baasemba okwongera amaanyi mu nteekateeka z’okulongoosa amazzi mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni wọ́n tún gbà á ní ìmọ̀ràn pé kí wọ́n ṣe ìmúgbèrú bá ètò ṣíṣe ìtọ́jú omi ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Baphinde babalula ukuthi kumele kuqiniswe ukuxhaswa kwezinhlelo zokuhlanza kwamanzi ezweni lase-Ethopia.
Hausa: Sun kuma bayar da shawarar haɓaka shirye-shiryen kula da ruwa a ƙasar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba šišinya go thuša ka mananeo a tlhwekišo ya meetse ka Ethiopia.

Source: The authors of this study were from Ethiopia.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’okunoonyereza kuno baali bava mu Ethipia.
